root = Stack([tabs1])
tabs1 = Tabs([tabOverview, tabDetails])
tabOverview = Tab("Overview", [g1, chCard])
g1 = Grid([m1, m2, m3])
m1 = Metric("Revenue", "1.2M kr", "This quarter")
m2 = Metric("Active users", "8 420")
m3 = Metric("Churn", "2.1%")
chCard = Card("Revenue by quarter", [ch1])
ch1 = Chart("bar", "", ["Q1", "Q2", "Q3", "Q4"], [{name: "Revenue", values: [210, 240, 260, 300]}])
tabDetails = Tab("Details", [p1, tbl1])
p1 = Progress("Storage used", 64, "64%")
tbl1 = Table("Top items", ["Item", "Price"], [["Compute", "3 200 kr"], ["Storage", "1 094 kr"], ["Support", "1 000 kr"]])
